objective.name: weather.fetch
objective.description: Fetch the current weather of a known French city from the open-meteo service (real internet access).

#root.role: Return the current temperature, apparent temperature, precipitation and wind of a known city.

city.description: City name, one of paris, lyon, marseille, lille.

transformation_contract.morphing: A city name becomes the weather observed there now.
invariants: The data comes from a real HTTP request to the open-meteo service: it is not deterministic.
An unknown city fails instead of returning a guess.
success: The response carries the city, the observation time and the four measures.
failure: The weather service is unreachable or does not answer within 10 seconds.
notes: Executed by the test_tools Python wrapper. Test infrastructure: the only capacity of the world that leaves the machine.

effects.tool_calls: Appends one entry to the tool_calls matter once the observation is in (done) or has failed (failed).
